title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode3 Doubt

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you talked to Mr. Hiiragi...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked him if he knew anything about us not receiving any offers... And, during our conversation, I remembered something really important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That we can't lose sight of our goal of spreading hope to others, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The fact of the matter is that we're not getting as many offers as before... But all we have to do is get back to that point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And as the producer of MORE MORE JUMP!, I'm going to think of a way for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I want the rest of you to keep thinking about spreading hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless of what sort of situation we're in, we can never lose sight of who we are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Haruka's right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not good for us to dwell on our problems. Our goal is to spread hope to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna try even harder in today's meeting for that show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since it's the first one where we get to appear as regulars!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All we did last time was introduce ourselves to everyone, but we get to hear more about it from the director today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Nakano was great to work with previously on “The Town Revitalization Team!”, and it's so nice that he's taking our input into account while developing this show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means we need to do our best and not let him down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of Mr. Nakano...
Didn't he also mention something about his next show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... He's gonna be working on another new show next year, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and he said how he'd love to have us on board for that as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know nothing has been decided yet...
But it might be worth asking him about that when we meet him today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In order to make that opportunity a reality and keep spreading hope to our viewers, we first need to do well during today's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
A few hours later
TV Station - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we end today's meeting here?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Sounds good. I think we've given a thorough rundown of what this show's about...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Next time, we'll talk more in detail about the segment you'll be leading.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really starting to come together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so excited!
We really get to run a segment where we help people who write to us about their problems...!

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're feeling so optimistic about it.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: The truth is, I had MORE MORE JUMP! in mind for this segment ever since I started working on this show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Really. When we shot “The Town Revitalization Team!”, you and the locals had such organic interactions... We got a lot of good footage as a result.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: My hope is that this segment will give our viewers another taste of that down-to-earth atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll once again show us your authentic selves when we begin shooting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line:
Slow down, Mr. Nakano.
We're not scheduled to actually shoot for ages. We still need to hammer out all the details first.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line:
Haha. Very true. I'm just so excited...
But...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: I do genuinely believe that MORE MORE JUMP! will help turn this show into an instant classic. So, once again, I'm very much looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we're looking forward to working with you again as well!

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line: Then, if no one has anything else to add, let's call things here, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I do have one question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that other show you mentioned when we last met... Has there been any progress?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: When we last met?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you mentioned that you'd be working on a new show next year and how you were interested in having us on board...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: O-Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Umm... Unfortunately, a few things happened with that show since we last spoke...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: And I'm sad to say that due to various reasons, we've gone back to the drawing board regarding who'll be appearing on it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? Back to the drawing board?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you tell us those reasons...?

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm not able to disclose that information...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, of course. Pardon me for asking...

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry since I indicated that you'd be appearing in it. I feel so awful about what's happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We understand...
As unfortunate as this is, we know that there's a lot going on behind the scenes. Regardless, we're still looking forward to working with you on another project.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: So am I.

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's clear the room.
We shouldn't overstay our welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They've gone back to the drawing board at this stage?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know it was still very preliminary, but Mr. Nakano seemed really excited about having us on...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Something isn't right here.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (While I'm already here at the station, I think I'll try talking to some of the staff I've worked with in the past.)
Several dozen minutes later
TV Station - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I understand.
And thank you for answering my questions. I know this was really sudden.

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry for not being able to help.
Anyway, Ms. Kiritani, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you. I look forward to working with you again if we get that chance.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm still grasping at straws...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I considered the possibility that we made some faux pas that everyone's too embarrassed to talk about... But, that's not the impression I've been getting.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But there's no use trying to think about this here. I need to refocus my attention.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Minori and the others have already gone.
I should head back to the MORE MORE HOUSE and—)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Nakano! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nakano
rows.Line: Ah, hello.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's Mr. Nakano...
He might've just gotten out of this other meeting. Before I leave, I should say goodbye and...)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: I heard the news about your new show for next year!

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: ReLight is going to appear on it as regulars, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(His new show for next year?
But he just said they'd gone back to the drawing board...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, did I just hear... ReLight...?)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: I was honestly really surprised since I know you're a huge fan of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I told them earlier that we're starting from scratch when it comes to who'll be appearing.

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line:
I made a huge mistake.
It's all my fault for jumping ahead and saying that they were basically a lock for it...

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I just ended up completely dashing their hopes.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
You know how things change really fast in this industry...

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: Also, there's nothing we can do when Mr. Hiiragi pushes so hard for his group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi...?
